## 4. Impact and Considerations

- **Potential impact:** Does this change affect existing functionality, downstream processes or other components?
- **Performance:** Are there any performance or scalability implications?
- **Data quality:** Could this change affect data accuracy, completeness, consistency or integrity?
- **Security:** Does the change introduce new dependencies, credentials or security considerations?

## 5. Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's coding standards and style guidelines.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my changes.
- [ ] I have added comments where necessary to explain complex logic.
- [ ] I have added or updated relevant tests.
- [ ] All relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] I have run the project's linting and formatting checks.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I have checked for unintended changes, debug code and sensitive information.
- [ ] I have considered potential performance and scalability implications.
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged or appropriately documented.
